name: 18437-penaltydecode-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine (guidellm vllm_python backend).
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 16 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 64, hidden 2048, vocab 128256, bf16, ~1.24B params = 2.5 GB.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 4096 requests / 900 s safety.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 256 tokens and output EXACTLY 256 (min = max both sides, ignore_eos). Every request carries `temperature: 1.0`, `top_p: 1.0`, `repetition_penalty: 1.05` (scenario.json `spec.backend.sampling_params`). `request_format: plain`, so no chat template is applied.
purpose: A compact billion-parameter writing assistant producing fixed 256-token replies for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The ungated mirror of the meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct weights; the Llama 3.2 Community
# License applies.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

max-model-len: 8192

# HAZARD: left unpinned this resolves to 1024 at this commit and the declared batch
# shape is not what runs.
max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

# V1 enables prefix caching by default, which skews latency at a fixed prompt shape.
enable-prefix-caching: false
